> **Note**: This issue is for discussion only. Once the proposal has traction,

> stage, you can [open an RFC PR directly](../../docs/rfcs/TEMPLATE.md).

**Why do you need this model field? What does it solve? Please describe.**
A clear and concise explanation of why you need this model field.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

| Field Name | Python Type | Description | Unique | Required | Index | Default Value |
| ---------- | ----------- | ----------- | ------ | -------- | ----- | ------------- |

**References**

| Source | Field Name Used | Link |
| ------ | --------------- | ---- |
| Example: Django auth | `is_active` | https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/stable/ref/contrib/auth/ |

| Source | Values |

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
